About Me

Turning data into decisions

I'm a Data Analyst and BI professional with a B.Sc. in Data Science from the University of Mumbai and around five months of professional experience working with real business datasets, dashboards and reporting pipelines.

My work spans data analysis, dashboard development, MIS reporting, automation and AI-powered analytics. I enjoy bridging the gap between raw data and clear business insight — building tools and dashboards that help teams make faster, better-informed decisions.

I've built projects across sales analytics, e-commerce reporting, NPA risk monitoring and AI-powered data profiling, and I'm actively expanding into ML and generative AI applications in analytics.
